description: This file implements machine name functionality for Drupal, including string trimming, transforming human-readable names into machine names, attaching behaviors to form elements, and transliteration support.

methods.name: trimByChar
methods.description: Trims a string by a specified character from both ends.

methods.name: prepareMachineName
methods.description: Transforms a human-readable string into a machine name, applying character replacements and length limits.

methods.name: showMachineName
methods.description: Displays the generated machine name and updates the preview element.

methods.name: transliterate
methods.description: Transliterates a human-readable name into a machine name, applying language-specific overrides.
